project_summary: A production-oriented SaaS application with a Next.js frontend, domain services, billing, and a growing automated test suite.
important_paths: src/app - application routes and server actions
full_gate_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
project_rules: Keep business logic outside UI components.
Reuse established repository patterns before introducing abstractions.
do_not_rules: Do not add dependencies without explicit justification.
Do not push, deploy, or run production migrations.

scoped_rules.name: frontend-boundaries
instructions: Keep server-only logic out of client components.

additional_skills.name: release-readiness
additional_skills.description: Run project release-readiness checks without publishing or deploying
instructions: Inspect the current diff and release checklist.
Run only verification commands already recorded by the project.
Report blockers and unverified claims; do not publish or deploy.

additional_agents.name: billing-researcher
additional_agents.description: Map billing behavior and risks without editing
instructions: Trace billing state, invoices, and payment-provider boundaries.
Return evidence with file paths and unresolved risks.

isolate_when: Broad codebase search or repository mapping
Log, build, or test output triage
always: Load reference material on demand; do not pre-load it.
Return conclusions and evidence, not raw file dumps.
